summary: Astron Space Exploration is an aerospace and orbital technology venture dedicated to advancing human and robotic presence beyond Earth's orbit. We design modular spacecraft systems, autonomous lunar landers, and deep-space telemetry solutions to support scientific missions, resource exploration, and commercial payload delivery.
